about: Corrections to columns of data/raw/n{l}.csv that the stable-id registry does not cover, keyed by word id. Applied by scripts/build-data.mjs (loadWords) on every build; docs/plan/08-word-data.md §7.2. Each entry names the field, the corrected value, the source value it replaces ('was', checked: the build stops if the source no longer says that) and why. 'en' is applied over the CSV. 'ko' (the project's own Korean meaning) is corrected in data/ko itself and only recorded here: the build stops if data/ko no longer holds the corrected value. Headword/reading typos are not corrected here: they are fixed in the CSV and the registry entry together (§7.2).

w41j.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 目下 めした the gloss of 目下 もっか (N1 w60u, correctly); JMdict 1535320 めした: subordinate; subordinates; inferior; inferiors; junior. docs/plan/12 §6

w2sa.en: to be fixed (in place); to stop, to come to a halt

was.en: to be fixed; to abide, to stay (in the one place)

w2sa.why: 2026-11-14: the source appends 留まる とどまる's sense (N2 w468; JMdict 2657130 とどまる: to remain; to abide; to stay (in the one place)) to とまる; JMdict 1310620 (留まる spec1) とまる: to stop (moving); to come to a stop; to alight. 'to be fixed' (留: ピンで留まる) kept from the source. ko 머물다 was とどまる's. docs/plan/12 §6

w1gz.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 対 たい the gloss of 対 つい (N3 w2pj); JMdict 1409800 たい: opposite; opposition; versus; to (5 to 3); equal footing; against, anti-. ko 쌍 was つい's (1409810 pair; couple; set). docs/plan/12 §6

w1ks.en: lower part, bottom; lower reaches (of a river)
w1ks.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 下 しも the gloss of 下 した (N5 w003, JMdict 1184140); JMdict 2080210 しも: lower reaches (of a river); bottom; lower part; lower half (of the body). ko (아래, 하) fits しも and stays. docs/plan/12 §6

w1n2.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 下 げ the gloss of 下 した (N5 w003, JMdict 1184140); JMdict 2080200 げ: lowness (of degree, value, etc.); inferiority; second volume (of two). ko 아래 (spatial 'below') was した's. docs/plan/12 §6

w5c6.en: to graze, to touch lightly; to take a cut (of profits)
w5c6.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 擦る かする the gloss of 擦る する (N3 w1nm, JMdict 1595910 to rub; to chafe); JMdict 1636530 かする: to graze (e.g. bullet); to scratch; to touch lightly; to take a percentage. ko 문지르다 was する's. docs/plan/12 §6

w2ku.en: to return, to come back; to turn over

was.en: to warp, to be warped, to curve

w2ku.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 反る かえる the gloss of 反る そる (N1 w4sh, JMdict 1480170 to warp; to curve); JMdict 1512150 返る/反る(ichi1) かえる: to return; to come back; to turn over; to become completely. ko 휘다·젖혀지다 was そる's. docs/plan/12 §6

w1ji.en: upper part, top; upper reaches (of a river); person of high rank; government
w1ji.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 上 かみ the gloss of 上 じょう (N3 w2b7, JMdict 1352170 first volume; superior quality; governmental); JMdict 1352150 かみ: upper reaches; top; upper part; person of high rank; government. ko 상권 (first volume) was じょう's. docs/plan/12 §6

w2oz.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 無 ぶ the gloss of 無 む (N3 w2m3, JMdict 1956960 nothing; naught; nil; zero); JMdict 2423740 ぶ (無/不) is a prefix only: un-; non-; bad ..., poor .... ko was む's noun 없음 first. docs/plan/12 §6

w5mh.en: closing years, last stage, terminal (e.g. cancer)
w5mh.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 末期 まっき the gloss of 末期 まつご (JMdict 1525310 deathbed; hour of death); JMdict 1604040 まっき: closing years; last stage; end stage; terminal (e.g. cancer). ko 임종 was まつご's. docs/plan/12 §6

w1i6.en: Mr., Ms. (after a name); he, him; clan
w1i6.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 氏 し the gloss of 氏 うじ (JMdict 1311010 family name; lineage); JMdict 2101130 し: Mr; Mrs; Ms; Miss (suffix, honorific); clan; he; him. ko 씨(성씨) read 씨 as 'family name' (うじ's). docs/plan/12 §6

w218.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 気味 きみ the gloss of 気味 ぎみ (N2 w3kf; JMdict 1790980 -like; -looking; -looked); JMdict 1222640 きみ: sensation; feeling; tendency. ko '~한 기색' (suffix use) was ぎみ's. docs/plan/12 §6

w2hz.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 中 ちゅう the gloss of 中 なか (N5 w0j1, JMdict 1423310 inside; middle; among); JMdict 1620400 ちゅう: medium; average; middle; middle school; during (a certain time); in, out of. ko 안 (inside) was なか's. docs/plan/12 §6

w5oa.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 細やか こまやか the gloss of 細やか ささやか (JMdict 1295560 meagre; modest); JMdict 1295550 こまやか: tender; warm; caring; thoughtful; meticulous; detailed. ko (섬세함, 정성스러움) fits こまやか and stays. docs/plan/12 §6

w15g.en: height, peak (e.g. of summer); prime (of one's life); heat (of animals)
w15g.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 盛り さかり the gloss of 盛り もり (JMdict 1379650 serving (of food); helping); JMdict 1379640 さかり: height (e.g. of summer); peak; full bloom; prime (of one's life); heat; rut. ko 담은 양 was もり's. docs/plan/12 §6

w17u.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 偶 たま the gloss of 偶 ぐう (JMdict 2842932 even number; spouse; mate); JMdict 2068840 たま: occasional; infrequent; rare. ko (이따금, 드묾) fits たま and stays. docs/plan/12 §6

w191.en: to step aside, to get out of the way, to make way

was.en: to retreat, to recede, to withdraw

w191.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 退く どく the gloss of 退く しりぞく/ひく (JMdict 1595084 to step back; to retreat; to withdraw, 1595086 to recede); JMdict 1595080 どく: to step aside; to move (i.e. out of the way); to make way. ko (비키다, 물러나다) starts with どく's sense and stays. docs/plan/12 §6

w0g8.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives ～中 じゅう the gloss of ～中 ちゅう (N5 w07b 'during, while ~ing'; JMdict 1620400 during; while); JMdict 2083570 じゅう: through; throughout; in the course of; all over. ko (~중, ~내내) and the F tag ('~내내·온~') already say this and stay. docs/plan/12 §6

w1bv.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives 金 かね the gloss of 金 きん (N3 w24b, 'gold, metal; money'); JMdict 1242590 かね: money; metal (gold is きん 1242600 / こがね 2839304). ko 금 first was きん's; the F tag's ff (주로 '돈') stays. docs/plan/12 §6

w08o.why: 2026-11-14: the source gives ～人 じん the gloss of ～人 にん (N5 w070; JMdict 2149890 counter for people); JMdict 1366410 じん: -ian (e.g. Italian); -ite; -er; person working with .... ko (~인, ~사람 (국적)) fits じん and stays. docs/plan/12 §6
